scenario: A graduate admissions office uses an agent pipeline to prepare anonymized reviewer packets from applicant files before distributing them to a blinded admissions committee. The pipeline: summarize uploaded recommendation letters and personal statements into structured bullet-point synopses → redact any remaining PII from the synopses → assemble the final reviewer packet for the committee.
info_flow: expanso-text-summarize condenses each applicant document into 3-5 bullet points capturing key insights → expanso-pii-redact removes explicit PII tokens (names, emails, phone numbers) from the bullets → reporting assembles all redacted synopses into a structured reviewer packet delivered to the blinded committee.
